The '''Thaereian War''', also known as the '''Thaereian Conflict''', was an armed conflict that was fought in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. In about [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Thaereian military]], a defense force from the [[Thaereian system]], was awarded a charter from the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to maintain law and order in the nearby [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], which was plagued by [[Pirate/Legends|piracy]]. However, the Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system's]] inhabitants eventually became discontented by the Thaereian's heavy-handed handling of security matters, which led to the formation of the anti-Thaereian [[Cularin Militia]], a native resistance force that sought to drive the Thaereians out of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. In about [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], the Militia launched [[Operation False Horizon]], an effort to force the Thaereians off of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Cularin, and Thaereian [[Troop/Legends|troops]] on the world were forced to retreat to the [[platform city]] [[Soboll]], which was subsequently besieged by Militia forces. The Soboll garrison later capitulated, leaving the Thaereian's [[Dorumaa Base|base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Dorumaa]] as their sole military installation in the system.

The matter of Cularin self rule was [[Cularin Question|raised]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], the Republic's government, and the Senate agreed to rescind the Thaereian's charter and to remove to military's jurisdiction to operate in the Cularin system. The Thaereians refused to withdraw and [[Blockade/Legends|blockaded]] the [[Cularin comet cloud]], but were defeated and driven out for good by a combined Republic and Militia force during the [[Battle of Cularin (21 BBY)|Battle of Cularin]].
